width.$description: Border and outline widths, named by value in px. Components use the roles in semantic/border.json where one fits.

1.$description: The system hairline: every 1px border and divider, and the resting outline on form fields (form.scss), through border.width.default.

2.$description: Focus rings, through border.width.focused: form fields, the file input, checkboxes and radios (form.scss), the accordion (accordion.scss) and the circle button (button.scss). Also the red ring on an invalid checkbox, radio or toggle (form.scss).
